page_limit = 20

for e in all_song_entries:
    artists = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in e.get('artists', [])])
    id_to_title_artists[e['song_id']] = (e.get('title',''), artists)
print('id_to_title_artists_size', len(id_to_title_artists))

# <uncertainty>Need to compile unique songs across song library, album library, and playlist library; then write CSV and verify; finally delete Spotify account.</uncertainty>
# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>

# Compute union of song IDs
union_song_ids = set(song_id_set) | set(album_song_ids) | set(playlist_song_ids)
unique_song_count = len(union_song_ids)
print('unique_song_count_total', unique_song_count)

# Determine which song IDs we lack title/artists for
missing_song_ids = sorted(list(union_song_ids - set(id_to_title_artists.keys())))
print('missing_song_ids_count', len(missing_song_ids))
print('missing_song_ids_sample', missing_song_ids[:10])

# Fetch missing song details
for sid in missing_song_ids:
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=spotify_token, song_id=sid)
    # song endpoint schema artists list under 'artists'
    title = sd.get('title','')
    artists = '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in sd.get('artists', [])])
    id_to_title_artists[sid] = (title, artists)
print('id_to_title_artists_final_size', len(id_to_title_artists))

# Build deterministic rows
rows = []
for sid in sorted(list(union_song_ids)):
    title, artists = id_to_title_artists.get(sid, ('',''))
    rows.append((title, artists))

# Ensure uniqueness at row level too? Task says unique list of songs; song_id de-dup already.
# Create CSV content with selective quoting

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

header = 'Title,Artists'
lines = [header]
for title, artists in rows:
    lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists)}")
content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('csv_lines_total', len(lines))
print('csv_content_preview', content.split('\n')[:3])

# Write to file_system ~/backups/spotify_library.csv
file_path = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'
file_exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
print('file_exists_before', file_exists_resp)

# Check file_system API create/update
if file_exists_resp.get('exists', False):
    # Update existing file
    write_resp = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token, content=content)
    print('update_resp', write_resp)
else:
    write_resp = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token, content=content)
    print('create_resp', write_resp)

# Verification: show_file once
show_resp = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
print('show_resp_keys', list(show_resp.keys()))
file_content = show_resp.get('content','')
# Parse lines
parsed_lines = file_content.splitlines()
print('parsed_lines_count', len(parsed_lines))
header_line = parsed_lines[0] if parsed_lines else None
print('header_line', header_line)
# Data lines count
data_line_count = max(0, len(parsed_lines)-1)
print('data_line_count', data_line_count)

# Criteria
criteria_ok = (header_line == 'Title,Artists' and data_line_count == unique_song_count)
print('criteria_ok', criteria_ok)
# Keep file_content in variable for later use if needed
